Sennheiser CX 685.  They are a little pricey but work well.  I got them for the gym and for when I run.  They stay in your ear pretty well even when your running and all sweaty. That might not be what your looking for but I figure I would throw it out there.  It's funny you posted this because they just crapped out on me last week after 2 years of daily use.  I've had Sony earbuds before them and they would only last about a year.

cs.th: Ask HN: What earbuds do you use? I need help

cs.t: Don't think the same. I remember when they removed the jack I was using iPhone with a pair of wired CX 880i's. On old iPhone they sounded great (of course not a true audiophile setup, just a comparison). After I got my iPhone 7 which removed the jack and gave the dongle instead, they sounded absolutely terrible through that DAC. The change might not be noticeable for average EarPods user, but those Sennheisers which were great earbuds for its time was literally sounding worse than back-then-not-so-good Bluetooth headphones through that DAC. With all the world moving to Bluetooth/wireless (speaking of casual use, not pro setups), I doubt this will ever change.
